claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Bergenin is a weakly cytotoxic polyphenol with anti-inflammatory/antioxidant activity and no plausible cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM, so it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
